key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:4282
name: return_without_action
description: Empty routine whose body is only a return, with no calls or memory writes. Referenced by address from elsewhere in the Council code, so it acts as a no-op placeholder entry.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:4288
name: poll_ring_buffer_until_result
description: Repeatedly fetches a value from a helper and passes it to a second helper until the result's low byte is non-zero or the fetch returns zero. Whenever the second helper's low byte is zero, it advances a 16-slot index held in the state block, wrapping at 16.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:42A0
name: fetch_until_low_byte_set
description: Loops over a helper call that fetches the next value and a second helper that consumes it, stopping when the consumed low byte is non-zero or the fetch returns zero. A zero low byte advances the 16-slot index in the state block, wrapping at 16.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:42C6
name: return_without_action
description: Empty routine whose body is only a return, with no calls or memory writes. Its only purpose in the code is as an entry that other routines can reference, so it is effectively a no-op stub.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:42CE
name: chain_calls_until_nonzero
description: Calls a getter, then repeatedly feeds its running value back into a second routine until the low 16 bits become non-zero. The loop returns the first non-zero value reached.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:42EC
name: chain_calls_then_finalize
description: Runs the same chain of calls until the low 16 bits become non-zero, then makes one final argument-free call before returning the value.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:4304
name: forward_call_to_helper
description: Makes one argument-free call to another routine and returns, so it works as a thin forwarding wrapper with no logic of its own.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:433E
name: translate_code_with_modifiers
description: Maps a 16-bit input code through two lookup tables held in the state block, with an indirect call for low codes, then clamps four specific values. Modifier bits in the argument add fixed offsets to the result, and zero input returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:4354
name: translate_code_with_device_call
description: Maps an input code like its neighbours but routes low codes through a library call that writes its result into a stack buffer. Modifier bits add fixed offsets, and the same four values are clamped afterwards.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:43A8
name: translate_code_from_registers
description: Maps a code taken from a register through the state-block lookup tables and clamps four specific values. Flag bits from a second register and a bit of the input add offsets to the result.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:43E0
name: adjust_code_and_add_flags
description: Subtracts a fixed offset from a 16-bit code when certain flag bits are set, clamps four specific values, then adds offsets for each flag bit. The result is zero when the code is zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:43EC
name: offset_code_by_flag_bits
description: Subtracts a fixed offset when a flag bit pattern is present, clamps four specific values, and adds offsets for the flag bits. It is a reduced form of the code-mapping routines above with no table lookup.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:43FA
name: lookup_table_code_with_flags
description: Maps a 16-bit code through a table in the state block for one code range, or adds a fixed offset for two adjacent codes, then clamps four values and adds flag-based offsets.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:440E
name: lookup_table_byte_with_flags
description: Reads a byte from a state-block table for a narrow code range, clamps four specific values, and adds offsets for the flag bits. Codes outside that range pass through unchanged.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:44A6
name: map_code_via_table_with_flags
description: Returns zero for a zero argument, otherwise looks up a byte in a state-block table by the low 7 bits of the code. It remaps five specific values to replacement codes and adds offsets for flag bits taken from the argument.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:4550
name: pop_ring_buffer_entry
description: Takes the next entry from a 16-slot ring buffer when its read and write indices differ, bracketed by exec library Forbid and Permit calls. If the entry's low 7 bits are a specific code, the following slot's two 16-bit halves are stored in two state variables.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:45E2
name: peek_ring_buffer_entry
description: Returns the entry at the current read position of a 16-slot ring buffer, or zero when the read and write indices are equal. It does not advance the read index.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:4606
name: consume_ring_entry_with_skip
description: Pops one entry from a 16-slot ring buffer between two indirect library calls. When the entry's low 7 bits are one of two specific codes, the following slot is also skipped.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:47D2
name: decompress_compressed_stream
description: Decodes a packed byte stream from a source buffer into a destination buffer. Control bytes select back-reference copies from already decoded output, counted block copies from the source, or repeated single-byte fills, and the loop ends when the requested output length is reached.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:48B0
name: call_helpers_with_table_pointers
description: Dereferences two pointers from a state-block table at indices taken from the second argument, then makes a fixed sequence of helper calls using the first argument, a stack-held 16-bit value and the dereferenced values.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:4934
name: forward_call_to_helper
description: Makes one argument-free call to another routine and returns, so it works as a thin forwarding wrapper with no logic of its own.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:494A
name: interleave_five_bitplanes
description: Copies bytes from five planes spaced 8000 bytes apart into one interleaved destination, five bytes per column and a 40-byte row stride. The plane base comes from a pointer table indexed by a state value, and the row and column counts come from the arguments.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:49A8
name: forward_call_to_helper
description: Makes one argument-free call to another routine and returns, so it works as a thin forwarding wrapper with no logic of its own.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:49BE
name: allocate_plane_buffer_with_header
description: Allocates a memory block sized from the two count arguments, stores the counts and a dimension value in its header, and records five plane pointers spaced 8000 bytes apart from a table entry. Library calls bracket the setup, and the block pointer is returned.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:4AD0
name: process_and_clear_node_list
description: Walks a singly linked list whose head is held in the state block, calling a helper on each node's payload, then sets the list head to zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:4AF8
name: clear_globals_and_set_pointer
description: Clears two global 32-bit variables, then calls two library functions obtained from a pointer table, one of which is an intuition call that sets the mouse pointer. It resets state before those calls.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:4D50
name: call_helper_with_saved_state_word
description: Saves a 16-bit state field, zeroes it, calls a helper, restores the saved value and returns one. The helper therefore runs with the field temporarily cleared.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:502C
name: draw_box_and_wait_for_input
description: Draws a framed box from a state table entry, optionally prints a short numeric label, then polls a library input call until a specific code value arrives. Two state fields are saved beforehand and restored at the end.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:51FE
name: show_insert_disk_prompt_and_wait
description: Draws a prompt box, optionally prints a numeric label, and waits for a specific input code before restoring the saved state fields. The referenced text is the prompt to insert a disk into any drive.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5244
name: await_prompt_input_with_lock
description: Saves two state fields, sets them to fixed values, draws a prompt, and waits for an input code while a library call is in effect. It then restores the fields and calls a disk-related helper before returning. The facts report a dos Lock call.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:52C4
name: retry_prompt_until_input
description: Repeats the prompt-and-input sequence until a valid input code arrives, then restores the same state fields and returns one.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:52CC
name: finish_prompt_and_release
description: Completes the prompt sequence by closing a pending handle when it is valid, restoring the saved state fields and making the final drawing calls. The facts show a dos UnLock call in the same routine.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5368
name: find_named_table_entry
description: Converts its argument into a string and searches a table of named entries for an exact match. On a match it follows link entries marked by a high bit to the final entry and returns its value, or minus one when no name matches.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:53C8
name: return_entry_word_by_index
description: Returns a 16-bit word from a table with 20-byte entries, selected by the index argument, with the high half of the result zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:53DC
name: find_next_named_entry
description: Advances the current index by one and searches the named table from there for a string match, following link entries as the full lookup does. It returns the matched value, or minus one when no further match exists.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:53E0
name: return_negative_one
description: Returns the constant minus one as a 32-bit value. The table lookup routines use it as the not-found result.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:53E8
name: update_rect_fields_by_step
description: Adjusts four 16-bit fields of the current entry in a state table by amounts tied to the argument. One field moves by the argument, and the others change by multiples of eight, two and sixteen times it.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5440
name: resolve_named_file_slot
description: Copies a stored name into a local buffer and, depending on the mode argument, probes for it with dos lock and open calls, retrying the lock in a loop. It releases any previously stored handle and records the result in a slot table, returning the slot index or minus one on failure.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5680
name: release_unused_named_slot
description: Checks that the given entry is present and that no slot in a ten-slot table references it. When none does, it releases the entry's stored pointer, clears it and returns one, otherwise it returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5720
name: find_lowest_priority_entry
description: Scans the 20-byte-stride table up to its first empty name and returns the index of the active entry with the smallest priority byte that also satisfies two comparisons against the inputs. It returns zero when no entry qualifies.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:57B4
name: close_display_and_free_resources
description: Runs an optional callback, then closes the window, screen and copper list resources through library calls, freeing colour maps and device handles and reopening the Workbench screen. Each handle is checked for non-zero before its close call.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5900
name: shift_three_byte_bit_chain
description: Shifts three adjacent state bytes by one bit as a chained register, carrying a bit from each byte into the next. It returns the XOR of two of the bytes after the shift.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:594C
name: refill_slot_and_read
description: If the table slot for the argument is empty, calls a helper to fill it, then makes a library read call through the pointer table.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5A22
name: remap_bit_planes_via_table
description: For each column across the bitplanes, gathers the bits into a value, maps that value through a byte table, and writes the mapped bits back into the planes when they differ. Plane count and row size come from the block header.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5A9C
name: remove_interrupt_server
description: Calls exec's RemIntServer through the library pointer table to remove an interrupt server registration. It does nothing else.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5AB0
name: check_named_entry_active
description: Converts its argument to a string and searches the named table for an exact match. It returns one when the matched entry's stored value is non-zero, and zero otherwise, including when nothing matches.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5B14
name: forward_call_to_helper
description: Makes one argument-free call to another routine and returns, so it works as a thin forwarding wrapper with no logic of its own.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5B2C
name: process_table_entry_if_present
description: Returns its inputs unchanged when the pointer argument is null. Otherwise it reads a value from a state table selected by the first input, calls a helper conditionally on a flag bit of the record, and then calls a second helper with that value.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5BA4
name: forward_call_to_helper
description: Makes one argument-free call to another routine and returns, so it works as a thin forwarding wrapper with no logic of its own.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5BBA
name: interleave_five_bitplanes_direct
description: Copies bytes from five planes spaced 8000 bytes apart into one interleaved destination, five bytes per column with a 40-byte row stride. The plane base is read directly from the first entry of the state pointer table.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5C10
name: select_font_record_state
description: Stores the argument as the current font record and copies its size and style fields into state, clearing one style bit. It then makes a library call for each populated slot in a pointer table, and the facts show a graphics SetFont call.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5C72
name: return_without_action
description: Empty routine whose body is only a return, with no calls or memory writes. It serves as a no-op entry that other routines can reference.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5C84
name: load_palette_from_state
description: Copies a value into a state buffer by calling a helper with that buffer's address, then makes two library calls through the pointer table. The facts identify one of them as graphics LoadRGB4, which loads a colour palette.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5CC0
name: shuffle_bytes_with_lookup_table
description: Remaps the bytes of a record's buffer row by row, swapping each byte pair through a 256-entry lookup table in the state block and toggling the record's flag bit afterwards. It returns the record unchanged when the pointer is null.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5D9C
name: multiply_halves_and_scale
description: Multiplies the high and low 16-bit halves of its argument, keeps the low 16 bits of that product, and multiplies the result by five.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5DB0
name: push_ring_buffer_entry
description: Writes a 32-bit value into the 16-slot ring buffer at the current write index and advances the index modulo 16. The write index is left unchanged when the new position would equal the read index, so the buffer never overfills.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5DE0
name: draw_string_segments_with_pens
description: Sets foreground and background pens and a drawing mode, then draws a null-terminated string in segments. Each segment is measured and drawn through helper calls, the position advances by the width returned, and the final advance width is returned.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5E32
name: draw_text_from_record
description: Walks the string held in a record field, drawing each segment through helper calls and advancing the record's pointer past it. It runs one library call first and returns the last advance width, using a fixed fallback width when no record is active.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5E4A
name: draw_text_and_advance
description: Moves the drawing position, then draws each segment of a string held in a record field and advances the field past it. It returns the last width used, with fixed default widths when no record is active.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5EBA
name: draw_text_segments_from_pointer
description: Walks a string from a pointer argument, advancing past each segment through helper calls until the terminating zero byte, and returns the final width.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5ECE
name: return_without_action
description: Empty routine whose body is only a return, with no calls or memory writes. It serves as a no-op entry that other routines can reference.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5ED8
name: expand_run_length_block
description: Decodes a run-length packed block whose output size is a 32-bit header value. Zero control words repeat the following byte for a counted run, negative ones fill with a repeated byte, and positive ones copy literal bytes until the header length is written.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5F48
name: call_library_when_value_set
description: Reads a 32-bit value from the argument and, when it is non-zero, calls a library routine at a fixed offset through the pointer table. The value is returned unchanged.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5F94
name: skip_encoded_record_chain
description: Follows a chain of encoded records by reading each record's type byte and jumping ahead by a size that depends on the type. Types zero and three skip two bytes, type four skips eight, and the result is returned from the last record reached.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:5FF8
name: sample_mouse_joystick_deltas
description: Advances two small timer counters in a state record, then reads the two joystick and mouse port registers and derives direction bits from their change since the previous sample. The bits are stored in a state byte and the routine returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:60D2
name: update_joystick_direction_flags
description: Sets direction bits in a state flag byte by comparing the high bytes of two port readings, and sets a further bit when a stored value differs from the last reading. It returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:60EC
name: update_fire_button_flags
description: Sets a status bit in a state byte, then flags a change when a 16-bit reading differs from the previous one. A further bit is set when a global input bit is clear; the input is the CIA port that carries fire buttons and disk status.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6120
name: dispatch_changed_input_bits
description: Builds a four-bit input state from two joystick-style words and stores it in a record. It then walks the eight bits of the changed-state byte and calls a handler for each bit that changed, with an extra bit read from a global table.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:61B8
name: layout_and_draw_wrapped_text
description: Splits a control-coded string into words and lines measured against the record's width limit. Break codes, position codes and spacing codes flush the pending word through drawing helpers, and a top bit on a character marks the final one.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6236
name: wrap_and_draw_text_run
description: Wrapping loop that flushes the pending word on break codes and returns at the end of the string. Its width test decides whether the word or its spill part is drawn first.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:626C
name: wrap_text_with_return_flush
description: Flushes pending text on each break code and at the end of the string, then returns. The pending word is measured against the width limit before the drawing order is chosen.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6290
name: wrap_text_from_break_code
description: Starts with a break-code check and flushes pending words through drawing helpers. A position code reads the next byte as a new column, and the loop continues until the string ends.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:62B4
name: wrap_text_loop_with_breaks
description: Repeats word measuring and drawing for each break code and returns when the string ends. Position codes read the following byte as a new column value.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:62E8
name: wrap_text_with_line_breaks
description: Runs the word-wrapping loop over a control-coded string, drawing each finished line through helper calls and returning at the terminator. Break codes end the current line.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6330
name: layout_text_with_space_codes
description: Handles a spacing code by padding with space characters up to a column position before drawing the segment. Other codes fall through to the same word-wrapping logic.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6358
name: wrap_text_run_with_tabs
description: Repeats the wrapping loop and handles tab-style position codes by reading the next byte as a column. Words are drawn through helpers as the loop advances.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:638C
name: wrap_text_with_pending_flush
description: Flushes the pending word before continuing the wrapping loop, then runs until the string terminator is reached.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:63D4
name: layout_text_with_tab_codes
description: Handles tab-style position codes by reading the next byte as a column and padding with spaces up to it before drawing. It then measures the next word against the width limit.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:63FC
name: layout_text_with_position_codes
description: Reads a column value at entry and then wraps lines of a control-coded string, measuring and drawing each word through helpers. It returns at the terminator.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6430
name: layout_text_after_position_set
description: Stores a column value from the string at entry, then runs the wrapping loop until the terminator. Words are measured against the record width and drawn through helper calls.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6486
name: wrap_text_with_width_reset
description: Word-wrapping loop that resets the column position at a line break, measuring each pending word against the record's width limit and drawing it through helper calls.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:64B2
name: pad_and_copy_wrapped_line
description: Handles a position code by inserting space characters up to the next column, copies the finished line into the output buffer, and then continues wrapping.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6500
name: flush_word_then_wrap_text
description: Flushes the pending word through drawing helpers and then runs the wrapping loop, returning when a terminator or break code is reached.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:651E
name: insert_space_and_wrap
description: Handles a space character by appending it as padding when it fits within the width limit, otherwise flushing the line first. The wrapping loop then continues.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:653A
name: pad_wrapped_text_with_fill
description: Pads wrapped text with a fill character supplied by the caller, flushing the pending word when it no longer fits, and returns when the string ends.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:656C
name: fill_and_flush_wrapped_text
description: Adds fill characters between words while the line still fits the width limit, then flushes the pending text through drawing helpers and continues the loop.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:65B2
name: copy_word_and_wrap_text
description: Flushes the pending word by copying it into the line buffer, adding a separating space when it fits, then continues wrapping until the terminator.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:65BE
name: flush_words_with_space_insertion
description: Adds separating spaces between words while they fit within the width limit, copies the completed line, and continues the wrapping loop.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:661C
name: emit_character_or_flush_line
description: Appends one character to the current word when it fits within the width, otherwise flushes the line and starts a new word with that character.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:662C
name: append_or_flush_wrapped_text
description: Appends characters to the current word while they fit within the width limit, and starts a new line through helper calls when they do not.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:669A
name: append_char_and_wrap_text
description: Stores the current character into the word buffer, then continues the wrapping loop, measuring and drawing words through helper calls until the string ends.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:66AA
name: flush_pending_word_if_any
description: Flushes the pending word through drawing helpers when it has content, choosing the draw order by comparing against the width limit. It does nothing when the word is empty.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:66D0
name: draw_word_if_within_width
description: Compares a character count against the remaining width and draws either the current word or its spill part through helper calls.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:66F2
name: draw_or_flush_by_width
description: Chooses between drawing the current segment and drawing its spill part by comparing a width value against the record width, using helper calls for each case.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6714
name: draw_word_and_line_buffers
description: Draws the word buffer and the line buffer through two helper calls, with no width comparison.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6736
name: format_pair_into_stack_buffer
description: Passes a 30-byte stack buffer to a helper twice and then returns, leaving the buffer contents to the callee.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6770
name: store_current_record_index
description: Stores the low 16 bits of its argument into the state block as the index of the current table record.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:677E
name: reset_record_and_wait_blit
description: Calls a helper with the current record's value, clears two fields of that record and a related state word, then calls the graphics WaitBlit through the library pointer table.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6804
name: write_record_fields_at_index
description: Stores four 16-bit values into a 16-byte record of the record table, selected by the low word of the first argument.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:684C
name: check_text_width_and_callback
description: Compares the record's column position against the width derived from the font record, calling a registered callback when it passes the limit and a flag is set. It then recomputes a column offset and calls a helper with it.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:686E
name: draw_wrapped_text_with_callback
description: Checks the column position against the record width and calls a registered callback when a flag is set and the limit is passed. It then computes and stores a column offset for the string segment and draws it through helpers.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6892
name: check_width_and_draw_segment
description: Tests the record column against a width limit, calling the registered callback when the limit is exceeded and the flag allows it. It then draws the segment through helpers at the current column.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:68CE
name: draw_segment_at_computed_column
description: Computes a column offset from the record width and the font record, draws the segment through a helper, and records a line-end position from the record's fields.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:68F0
name: draw_segment_if_overflowing
description: Draws a segment at a computed column when the record column exceeds the width limit, then stores a line-end position from the record.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6912
name: draw_segment_and_set_column
description: Draws a string segment through helper calls and sets the record column from the width value, then records the line-end position.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6938
name: record_segment_width_and_length
description: Computes a column width from the font record, draws the string through helper calls, and stores the width along with the string length in the record. It starts a new line counter when the record width is exceeded.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6956
name: draw_segment_and_track_length
description: Draws a string segment between its start and end columns, then adds the string length to the record position.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6972
name: record_string_length_and_wrap
description: Measures a string by walking to its terminator and adds that length to the record column. It starts a new line when the record width is reached.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6A12
name: advance_column_after_string
description: Draws a string segment and advances the record column by its length, starting a new line when the width is reached.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6A92
name: store_segment_width_and_end
description: Stores a width computed from the argument in the record, adds the string length to the column and clears the string buffer's terminator slot. It starts a new line when the width is exceeded.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6AAA
name: store_line_width_and_advance
description: Stores a width derived from the argument in the record, adds the string length to the column, and starts a new line when the width is exceeded. It clears the string buffer's terminator slot.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6AF4
name: start_new_line_if_overflowing
description: Starts a new line counter when the record column exceeds the width limit, then clears the string buffer's terminator slot.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6B1E
name: start_new_line_if_range_exceeded
description: Starts a new line when a width value falls outside a range relative to the record width, then clears the string buffer's terminator slot.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6B44
name: draw_segment_then_advance_column
description: Draws a string segment at an offset from the record, then advances the column by the string length and starts a new line when the width is reached.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6BA0
name: advance_column_and_wrap_line
description: Adds the string length to the record column, starts a new line when the width is reached, and clears the string buffer's terminator slot.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6BD6
name: start_new_line_when_full
description: Starts a new line when the record column exceeds the width limit derived from the font record, then clears the string buffer's terminator slot.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6C00
name: reset_line_counter_on_range_check
description: Clears the record's column value and increments its line counter when a width value minus eight is below a limit, then clears the string terminator slot.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6C38
name: call_indirect_function_from_stack
description: Calls a routine through a pointer loaded from the stack-held argument at a fixed offset, passing nothing. The facts report a library call at that offset.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6C6C
name: init_self_pointer_node
description: Writes the node's own address into its first longword, adds four to that stored value, clears the next word and stores the node address in the third longword. It sets up a self-referencing node header.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6C80
name: return_without_action
description: Empty routine whose body is only a return, with no calls or memory writes. It serves as a no-op entry that other routines can reference.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6C82
name: return_without_action
description: Empty routine whose body is only a return, with no calls or memory writes. It serves as a no-op entry that other routines can reference.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6C84
name: fetch_value_or_minus_one
description: Returns minus one when the pointer from a helper is null. Otherwise it calls a helper when a flag bit is set, reads a value from the pointed-to record through a second helper, and returns minus one when a state word is non-zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6CE8
name: record_dos_error_and_fail
description: Calls a library routine through the pointer table and, when it reports failure, stores the DOS error code from IoErr in a state field, sets a status value of two and returns minus one. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6D20
name: parse_command_line_arguments
description: Splits a command-line string into up to 32 argument pointers, honouring quoted arguments and star escapes for a newline and an escape code. The facts show dos open and console calls around it, using a console window specification string.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6F58
name: run_registered_handlers_backward
description: Walks a table of six-byte handler entries backward from its count, calling each enabled entry whose flag bit is clear, and then calls a final routine with the argument.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6F7C
name: run_registered_handlers_backward
description: Walks a table of six-byte handler entries backward from its count, calling each enabled entry whose flag bit is clear, and then calls a final routine with the argument.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:6FD8
name: uppercase_flagged_string_bytes
description: Walks a zero-terminated string and subtracts the case offset from each byte whose class flag is set in a state table, converting those characters to upper case in place. It returns the original pointer.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:701C
name: append_string_with_length_limit
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most the given maximum number of characters and terminating the result with a zero byte. It returns the destination pointer.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:7078
name: compare_strings_ignoring_case
description: Compares two byte strings character by character with lower-case letters folded to upper case. It returns the difference between the first mismatching pair, or zero when the strings are equal.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:70B4
name: append_string_to_end
description: Finds the terminator of the destination string and copies the source string onto its end, including its zero byte. It returns the destination pointer.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:70CC
name: find_byte_in_string
description: Scans a zero-terminated string for the given byte and returns a pointer to its first occurrence, or null when it is absent.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:70F2
name: forward_argument_to_helper
description: Passes its argument straight to another routine and returns, with no further logic of its own.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:710C
name: find_last_byte_in_string
description: Scans a zero-terminated string and returns a pointer to the last occurrence of the given byte, or null when that byte does not appear.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:712C
name: return_without_action
description: Empty routine whose body is only a return, with no calls or memory writes. It serves as a no-op entry that other routines can reference.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:7134
name: format_signed_decimal_string
description: Writes a minus sign when the value is negative, then produces its decimal digits in reverse order and copies them into the buffer after the sign. It null-terminates the result and returns the length written.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:7140
name: format_decimal_with_overflow_sign
description: Converts a number to decimal digits and copies them into the buffer, writing a minus sign when the overflow and negative status flags differ. It null-terminates the result and returns the length written.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:7174
name: free_linked_node_list
description: Walks a singly linked list of nodes, releasing each through a library call, then clears the list head and tail pointers to zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:71A4
name: get_pointer_value_or_minus_one
description: Returns minus one when a helper returns a null pointer. Otherwise it reads a value from that record through a second helper and returns minus one when a state word is non-zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:71F4
name: process_flagged_list_nodes
description: Walks a linked list of records starting from a state field, calling a helper for each record whose flag byte has one bit set and the other bit clear, and whose two 16-bit fields differ. A final helper call follows the walk.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:7244
name: write_and_record_io_error
description: Clears the stored error code and makes a library write call. On failure it records the DOS error code and sets a status value of five, then returns the call's result.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:7294
name: seek_and_adjust_file_position
description: Clears the stored error code and calls a library position routine, recording the DOS error code and status on failure. It then adjusts the returned position: in relative mode the result is added to the argument, and in other modes the library routine is called again to read the position.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:730C
name: reset_record_and_free_memory
description: Sets a status byte to 255 and two long fields to minus one, then releases the record's memory through a library call.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:7338
name: remove_port_and_free_signal
description: Removes a message port and frees its signal and memory through library calls, after clearing a status byte and a long field. The memory is released last.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:7378
name: close_dos_handle
description: Calls a helper when a state field is set, then closes a DOS handle through the library pointer table and returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:739C
name: multiply_fixed_point_values
description: Multiplies two 32-bit fixed-point values held in registers by combining their high and low halves, including the cross terms, and returns the 32-bit product.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:73BC
name: divide_fixed_point_values
description: Divides one 32-bit fixed-point value by another, negating the result when the signs differ. The divisor is normalised with shifts, and a zero high half falls back to a plain 32-bit division.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:73D4
name: negate_64bit_result
description: Calls a helper that returns a 64-bit value and returns the negation of its high and low 32-bit halves.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:73DE
name: divide_32bit_by_16bit
description: Divides a 32-bit register value by a 16-bit divisor in another register and returns the 32-bit quotient. A negative divisor is handled by calling a helper and negating its result.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:73EE
name: divide_with_remainder_pair
description: Divides a 32-bit value by a 16-bit divisor and returns the quotient and remainder together in one 64-bit result. Large divisors take a normalising shift path before the division.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:7418
name: compute_reciprocal_fixed_point
description: Normalises a 16-bit divisor by shifting, then divides the dividend by it with a correction step. It returns a fixed-point quotient.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:7480
name: copy_message_and_write_output
description: Copies a length-prefixed string into a local buffer capped at 79 characters, then writes it through a library output call with a trailing newline when an output stream is active. It returns minus one on that path and zero otherwise.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:74A2
name: write_break_notice_message
description: Copies a message into a local buffer, terminates it, and writes it through a library output call with a newline when an output stream is active. The referenced text is a break-notice prefix, and it returns minus one on that path.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:750A
name: open_intuition_window_or_fail
description: Opens the intuition library through the pointer table and stores the handle in a local slot. It then opens a window of 250 by 60 units with that handle, returning zero on success and minus one otherwise.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:7522
name: open_intuition_window_fixed
description: Stores the local message buffer as the window title and opens a window of 250 by 60 units through a helper. It returns zero on success and minus one otherwise.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:755A
name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns the constant zero without any other operation or memory access.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:75B8
name: allocate_typed_node
description: Allocates a memory block when the argument is non-zero, sets its type byte to five and a flag byte to zero, and stores the argument at a fixed offset in the block. It returns the block, or zero when nothing was allocated.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:75F4
name: create_port_with_signal
description: Allocates a signal through a library call and, on success, allocates a node and fills in its type, owner task and list links. On failure it releases the signal, and when the first argument is zero it initialises an empty list header.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:7684
name: get_table_entry_checked
description: Returns the address of a six-byte table entry when the index is within the count and the entry is in use. Otherwise it clears the error field, sets it to nine and returns zero.

key: eye of the beholder - advanced dungeons& dragons (1990)(ssi)(de)[a](disk 3 of 3)/Eye of the Beholder - Advanced Dungeons& Dragons (1990)(SSI)(De)[a](Disk 3 of 3).adf:Council.Cps:0:76C4
name: dispatch_signal_handler
description: Reads the signal state through a library call and, when mask bits are set and a registered handler is present and returns non-zero, clears the handler slot and calls the cleanup routine.
